facts.title: Baked Feta Dip with Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 medium cloves garlic, peeled but left whole
⅓ cup Kalamata olives, halved lengthwise and pitted (optional)
Pinch of red pepper flakes (optional, for heat)
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
For serving: Crostini or baked pita wedges or crackers
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
